# Iron Never Changes

> Iron Never Changes is a heavyweight gym wear brand for everyday men with jobs, kids and a bar in their week. It sells 28 screen-printed, garment-dyed gym shirts at $34 to $42 on ironneverchanges.com, shipped to US addresses, plus coaching with Zac at $100 a month.

The shirts carry plain, honest lines about showing up, hard times and keeping your head straight: "I didn't feel like it either", "Proud of you. Somebody should say it.", "Say it out loud. It weighs less.", "The bar doesn't know you're tired", "Lost, not gone." The name finishes as "Iron never changes. You do." House slogan: "Where limits meet defeat."

## The line

- 28 shirts, SKUs INC-001 to INC-028, $34 to $42 each in US dollars.
- Every shirt comes in all four garment-dyed washes: washed black, washed blue, washed brown and washed grey.
- Every shirt comes in sizes S, M, L, XL, 2X and 3X.
- Heavyweight tees, screen printed in one color of ink: white ink on washed black and washed blue, black ink on washed brown and washed grey. The print cracks and fades with wear. No tech fabric, no neon.
- Garment dye varies a little from shirt to shirt, so a wash may not match the photos exactly.
- $34: [THE HOUSE SHIRT](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc007), [IT FIXES ENOUGH](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc019), [THE SPOTTER](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#inc021)

## How buying works

- The shop is always open. No drops, no countdown: every shirt, wash and size is on sale at the price on its card.
- Pick a wash and a size, add it to the cart, and pay on Stripe Checkout. Card details go to Stripe and never touch the site.
- Ships to US addresses only, at a flat $6 per order however many shirts are in it.
- All sales are final, with no returns or exchanges. If an item arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered, email ironneverchanges@gmail.com with your order details and a photo for a replacement or a refund.

## Coaching

- [The Corner](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#corner): coaching with Zac, $100 a month, month to month, no contract, cancel any time.
- Included: meal plans built from real groceries, lifting programs built around your schedule and equipment, unlimited talk and text with your coach, video form checks on the big lifts, a progress portfolio tracked month over month, and the plan rebuilt every four weeks.
- Most of Zac's clients are losing weight, keeping their strength and getting back to feeling like themselves. Nobody is trained for a stage.
- To start, email ironneverchanges@gmail.com. Coaching is set up with Zac directly, not through the shirt checkout.
